scope: Focused Firefox 159 verification of earlier Firefox 146 parity work; no application changes or complete parity claim

matrix.detail: Existing inspector reports contradictions; hardware/OS inference remains advisory.

Edit cancellation preserves config/overrides. Generation cancellation restores identity preferences before publication. Runtime edit guard and Node generation tests pass; full live UI interaction remains unverified.
Local Firefox159 runtime checks cover cookies, local/session storage, IndexedDB, CacheStorage, SharedWorker, BroadcastChannel, other-origin separation and profile restart with positive controls.

matrix.feature: Service-worker registration/identity and HTTP-cache isolation coverage
matrix.detail: Same-origin non-default owners cannot read each other's registrations/storage/cache. Explicit configured page and worker identities, independent writes, same-owner worker state and HTTP-cache reuse are checked.
Not part of this verification. No Castle requests or port work performed; historical deferral is not a current parity claim.
All 12 listed patches exist in order. Patch presence and focused tests do not establish complete engine/runtime/proxy parity.

browser.profiles: Disposable only; personal profile not used

review.finding: Prior page/worker equality could pass if both identities were wrong.
review.resolution: Require each configured populated owner identity for pages and all worker types at setup/return/reload; require different owner identities. Assert fetch bodies and B setup success.
review.final: Independent review: no open blocking findings.

limitations: Only installed Firefox159 on macOS was exercised now; no fresh Firefox146/158 verification.
Settings probe imports the maintained inspector and sandboxed edit handler, uses installed Overrides module and a stubbed config builder. Generation handlers use Node with simulated UI/prefs.
No live settings-page click test, rebuild or reinstall performed for this task.
Local TLS fixture uses temporary self-signed certificate acceptance with loopback-only DNS. No external proxy/TLS/exit-IP parity assessment.
Full native privacy parity and Castle lab are not established.
local_artifacts: Raw logs and tools remain untracked under .tools159/parity-probe-review; checkpoints retained.
